name: The Lament

frame.name: Banshee's Wail
frame.description:
[Block]  : Hold to rev the blade.
 • Increases damage and adds [Shield-Piercing] shield piercing to all attacks.
 • Gain stacks when dealing damage with revved attacks.
 • Additional stacks increase the damage and damage resistance of heavy attacks.

perks.name: Jagged Edge
perks.description: Increased damage at the cost of sword ammo.

perks.name: Enduring Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has high endurance, but low resistance.

perks.name: Tireless Blade
perks.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.

perks.name: Revved Consumption
perks.description: Damaging a combatant heals the wielder.

flavor: The last thing the Vex ever heard—the grinding wails of a vicious Banshee.

catalyst.name: The Lament Catalyst
catalyst.description: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.
